title: Mean, median, mode and range
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.stat.center.mean: Add all the values, then divide by how many there are.
hints.stat.center.median: Put the values in order first. With an even number of values, average the two in the middle.
hints.stat.center.mode-range: Mode: the value that appears most. Range: largest minus smallest.
hints.stat.center: Mean: add and divide. Median: order, then the middle. Mode: most common. Range: largest − smallest.

misconceptionMessages.stat.mean-sum: That's the total. Divide it by how many values there are to get the mean.
misconceptionMessages.stat.mean-wrong-count: Count the values again: divide by how many there are.
misconceptionMessages.stat.mean-missing-average: The mean isn't the missing number. Find the total (mean × how many), then take away the ones you know.
misconceptionMessages.stat.median-unsorted: Put the values in order before finding the middle.
misconceptionMessages.stat.median-even: There are two middle values. The median is halfway between them: add them and divide by 2.
misconceptionMessages.stat.median-mean: That's the mean. The median is the middle value once they're in order.
misconceptionMessages.stat.mode-count: That's how many times it appears. The mode is the value itself.
misconceptionMessages.stat.mode-median: That's the middle value. The mode is the one that appears most often.
misconceptionMessages.stat.range-ends: Use the largest and smallest values, not the first and last in the list.
misconceptionMessages.stat.range-max: That's the largest value. The range is largest − smallest.

sections.title: The mean
sections.objective: Find the mean, and a missing value from the mean.
explain: The mean (average) shares the total out equally: if everyone had the same amount, how much would each get?
sections.key: Mean = total ÷ how many. To find a missing value: total = mean × how many, then take away the ones you know.

sections.title: The median
sections.objective: Find the middle value, with an odd or even number of values.
explain: The median is the middle value when the data is in order. Half the values are below it, half above.
sections.key: Order the values first. Odd count: the middle one. Even count: halfway between the two middle ones.

sections.title: The mode and the range
sections.objective: Find the most common value and the spread.
explain: The mode is the value you see most often. The range tells you how spread out the data is.
sections.key: Mode: the value that appears most (the value, not how many times). Range: largest − smallest.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Mean, median, mode and range, mixed.
explain: Now the questions are mixed. Read which one is asked.
sections.key: Mean: add and divide. Median: order, then the middle. Mode: most common. Range: largest − smallest.
